notes.title: Fascinating Changes In Car-toon Chaos
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974890/9d039241811fa41c94767e1d89830c332fe9ee43.png
Some changes have occurred in the game. 
[olist]
Girls have been replaced with Chicks, or beak girls, because ducky hardbeak isn't a super freak who goes after other species.
Bugs with menu options have been fixed
New internal Unity Engine Upgrade, leading to use of Direct 3D in build
and other smaller changes
[/olist]

Remember, Bang City may have police, but it won't save itself without Ducky Hardbeak! 
"Oh boy Oh Boy oh BOY!!"

notes.title: Lots of updates for Car-toon Chaos
notes.content:
BIG UPDATES FOR CAR-TOON CHAOS
Minimap now rotates towards your vision on flat screen
New Multiplayer map added "Lost City"
Terrain by robot lab now less likely to get stuck in
Performance bugs fixed for "Protecting the mayor" level
Button in cutscenes bigger now for VR
